- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (positive sentiment > 0.5) — reduce forecast peak by 5–10%.
- Underestimate prices during strong negative sentiment (sentiment < -0.5) — add 3–7% to forecast to avoid underreaction.
- Avoid overreacting to recent spikes — cap 30d forecast max at 1.5x recent 7d high to prevent overshoot.
- Mean-revert forecasts if sentiment is neutral or mildly bullish (0.0 to 0.3) — adjust downward 1–2% from peak if no strong trend.
- Lag correction: if sentiment peaks 2–3 days before forecast horizon, reduce forecast by 2–4% to account for delayed market reaction.
- For 30d forecasts, if true outcome exceeds forecast by >5% for 3+ consecutive days, reduce next forecast by 3–5% to avoid momentum bias.
